B.name: Balanced Public Value
B.instruction: Balance risk reduction, continuity, resilience, inclusion, opportunity, and feasibility.

E.name: Equity / Need-First
E.instruction: Prioritize evidenced vulnerability, basic services, unequal exposure, accessibility, and inclusion; do not invent vulnerable groups.

R.name: Risk-Reduction / Resilience
R.instruction: Prioritize preventable harm, disaster exposure, safety, continuity, and recurring risks.
